23:15 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Football
The TCU Horned Frogs (4-4) face the No. 24 Arizona Wildcats (6-2) at Casino Del Sol Stadium in a Big 12 matchup. TCU enters after defeating Kansas 22-16 behind Jaden Craig, while Arizona fell 34-26 to Texas Tech and relies on quarterback Noah Fifita.
